text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- King Hussein and UAE leader Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan emphasise the need to revive Arab solidarity, the two leaders call for continuing the peace process to attain a just and comprehensive peace.
- Heavy rains cover the kingdom and thunder storms expected on Sunday.
- Transfer on Sunday of the carpet donated by King Hussein to the Dome of the Rock Mosque to Jerusalem.
- Cabinet decides the basis of the royal pardon of detainees, study of the convicted on a case-by-case basis and excluding crimes that harm national security.
- King Hussein and UAE leader call for the "dismantling of all obstacles between brothers and proceeding ahead in the peace process."
- Acting Prime Minister Nsour discusses with Syrian Foreign Minister bilateral ties and the crisis on peace moves.
- Border patrol seize weapons and smuggled cigarettes from infiltrators.
- Amman hosts exhibition of equipment and light weapons for special forces.
- Parliament to begin work on draft laws on Wednesday.
- Information Minister Muasher's visit to Israel not finalised yet.
